# AO Readme
*Last updated 09/23/16*

**IMPORTANT!** This software is currently ALPHA, and is not intended for general use.

AO is a collection of useful tools and utilities. This version of AO is designed for .NET C#.

While I have attempted to make this code easy to read, it's also heavily commented because:

1. I intend to use this framework going forward, and two years from now I won't remember why I wrote
       something the way I did

2. I want it to be completely clear to the reader what is being accomplished

Eventually I will make a "light" version of AO.cs available, without the comments. Until then, please feel free to
remove all but the file headers if you use AO.cs for your projects.

For more information about AO, please visit http://aprettycoolprogram.com/ao.
